title: Sign character as support parity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\gamma\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$. The sign character $z\mapsto(-1)^{\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i z_i}$ equals the sign function that is $(-1)^{\sum_{i\in\operatorname{supp}(\gamma)}z_i}$, with both sums computed in $\mathbb F_2$.
